bias.zh: 回落 · 位于 5 日和 10 日均线下方，测试 $591–595

read.en: Lumentum fell 4.5% on Nov 13 to $596.62, trading $569.00–624.00 on light volume (0.56x the 20-day average). It is below the rising 5-day ($610.2), the 10-day ($609.1), 30-day ($817.6), 100-day ($841.6) and rising 200-day ($813.9). MACD has been below its signal since Oct 13, below zero, histogram narrowing; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Nov 2 ($768.53), and RSI is 37.4.
read.zh: Lumentum 11月13日下跌 4.5%，收于 $596.62，盘中区间 $569.00–624.00，成交量偏低（20 日均量的 0.56 倍）。股价位于上行的 5 日均线（$610.2）以及 10 日（$609.1）、30 日（$817.6）、100 日（$841.6）和上行的 200 日均线（$813.9）下方。MACD 自 10月13日起位于信号线下方，在零轴下方，柱状图收窄；抛物线 SAR 自 11月2日起看空（$768.53），RSI 为 37.4。

read.en: The close lost the 5-day; the $569 low undercut the $594.8–602.3 Jul 28–29 lows, but the close finished back inside that band. Resistance is $602.3–610.2 (Jul 28 low, 10 and 5-day), then $624–633.6 and $644–651. Support is $585.6–594.8, then $569–570.4 (Nov 13 and 10 lows) and $545. A close above $610.2 would target $624–634; below $585.6, $569–570.

r.en: Nov 13 high $624; Nov 12 close $624.65; Nov 4 close $626.75; Nov 11 low $633.59
